ast.scope: Explicit gap: no syntax projection or semantic AST.

obernants.scope: U contains (positive sent, world section map, secs,fut,bonus,insec). R follows ordered branches: empty=0, same=3, future next=2.5, adjacent=0.5, otherwise=-1.5. U minus R includes additive combinations of these mutually exclusive bonuses and next=2.5 without fut.

Bonus 2.5 implies nonempty secs, sec absent from secs, fut=true and some x with sec=x+1. Bonus 0.5 requires adjacency and failure of earlier branches. Preserve all sets/lists and world maps meeting these constraints.
Positive out-of-range sent maps to sec=0, which may receive same-section bonus if q.secs includes 0. sent=0 underflows the subtraction in checked builds and is not covered by this valid-domain model.
Hold sec,secs fixed and toggle fut. Only outside-same cases with an immediately preceding queried section move from adjacency 0.5 to 2.5; score delta is 2.0. All other finite inputs preserve bonus.

For positive sent let sec=text[sent-1].section if present, otherwise 0. Bonus=3 fiber is secs containing sec; bonus=2.5 fiber excludes same-section and requires fut and a preceding sec-1 member; bonus=0.5 fiber excludes both prior cases and requires adjacent membership; bonus=-1.5 excludes them all with nonempty secs; empty secs gives 0. At sec=0 no preceding section exists, so fut cannot make fallback a next-section match. Anchors are free in this projection. Preserve every compatible text map and query list, including duplicates.

coverage.description: Resolve sec from world sentence at sent-1, falling back to 0 for out-of-range positive sent; choose one section bonus by ordered conditions.
